pagesHistory1Heading.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.

pagesHistory1.message: Clarified that All windows includes the current Chrome profile. Added a short voiced demo of live preview, search, and keyboard navigation.
pagesHistory1.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.

pagesHistory2Heading.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.

pagesHistory2.message: Added optional Support TabShow and Buy me a coffee links. Every feature remains free, and support is entirely optional. Enter follows a focused link; Escape still returns to your original tab.
pagesHistory2.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.

pagesHistory3Heading.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.

pagesHistory3.message: Added a local Tab Chaos Score, dark, light, or system appearance, Suggest a feature and Tell a friend actions, and stable OPEN TABS and window totals while searching.
pagesHistory3.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.

pagesHistory4Heading.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.

pagesHistory4.message: Added search, keyboard navigation, all-window scope, flexible sorting, richer tab context, and clearer loading and empty states.
pagesHistory4.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.

pagesHistory5Heading.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.

pagesHistory5.message: Added adjustable hover delay, preview loading feedback, faster access to settings, and a direct rating link.
pagesHistory5.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.

pagesHistory6Heading.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.

pagesHistory6.message: Introduced color settings, improved live titles and favicons, and refreshed the TabShow identity and store listing.
pagesHistory6.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.

pagesHistory7Heading.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.

pagesHistory7.message: Redesigned tab groups, improved hover reliability, and added full-address tooltips and the feedback board.
pagesHistory7.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.

pagesHistory8Heading.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.

pagesHistory8.message: Made large tab collections dramatically faster and added the welcome and release pages.
pagesHistory8.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.

pagesHistory9Heading.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.

pagesHistory9.message: Launched hover preview, tab closing, keyboard access, and visual tab groups.
pagesHistory9.description: Text on the TabShow release notes page.
